turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Sure. To ask about the past, use: (question word) + did + subject + base verb?
What did you do last weekend?
Did you watch TV yesterday?
After did, the verb does not change.

Exercise: Make a question with did:
you / visit / your grandmother / last weekend?
